description: Phase 1 repro — 60fps clip looping past a section break under sectionBehavior=Normal. Continuation phase advances at clip.framerate=60, but DecodeSystem still derives its decode target from the (frozen) timeline frame during the at-break pause. The decoder stops feeding the cache past `breakMediaFrame + DECODE_AHEAD_FRAMES`, so PlaybackPresenter's exact-cache hits start missing; with playState=Paused the nearest-frame fallback is gated off and the texture freezes until phase wraps to a cached frame. Visible as choppy stutter. GAP: no SetTimelineFrameRate script command — timeline stays at default 30fps; the 60fps clip framerate alone drives the divergence (phase advances at 60Hz, decode target at the timeline-derived rate). Once SetTimelineFrameRate exists, set it to 60 to amplify.
